newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-OLAZABAL WINS IN THIRD COMEBACK TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OLAZABAL WINS IN THIRD COMEBACK TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Jose Maria Olazabal fired a final round 67 on Sunday to win the Turespana Masters at Maspalomas -- only his third tournament since his comeback after 18 months out of the game.
The Spaniard's 20-under par total of 272 gave him a two-shot victory over Briton Wayne Westwood.
Olazabal returned to golf at the Dubai Classic on February 27 after his long lay off because of rheumatoid arthritis in his feet.
He finished equal 12th in Dubai and last week improved to joint fourth in the Portuguese Open.
Jose Maria Olazabal, the 31-year-old Spaniard, made one of the great sporting comebacks when he won the Turespana Masters at Maspalomas in Gran Canaria today.

He had finished joint 12th in the Dubai Desert Classic on his return earlier this month and then finished joint fourth in the Portuguese Open in Lisbon last week.
Today was his 16th European Tour victory and he won by two shots from England's Lee Westwood, who shot a final round 71 for 274.
